title: 9 Phrases a Godly Man Retires as He Grows Up
caption:
You can tell a lot about a man by the small things he says without thinking.

"I'm fine." "Just kidding." "I'll pray for you." "Five minutes away." None of them feel like a big deal. That's the point. They're how a man gets comfortable being one guy on the outside and another on the inside.

A godly man grows into a man whose words mean exactly what they say.

"Let what you say be simply 'Yes' or 'No.'" Matthew 5:37

Which one are you retiring first? Send this to the brother who'll keep you honest about it.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #integrity #honesty
